images.prompt: Photorealistic cinematic film still, warm amber and gold color grade, ancient Persian forest, fine film grain. Upper 40 percent of the frame is dark shadow for text; subject in the lower half. Animals with natural correct anatomy. NO people, no humans anywhere. No text, letters, logos or watermarks. low-angle shot looking up at the subject, towering over the camera, sky and buildings converging behind. soft motivated window light from one side, gentle falloff, natural. A domestic-size wild tabby cat sitting politely with its tail curled, head tilted sweetly toward a small round mouse hole at the base of an ancient mossy stone wall overgrown with tree roots, warm side light. Only the cat.
